text:
anna: FYI staging keystore started failing healthchecks after the egress-proxy change. KMS decrypts are timing out and we're missing decrypt audit events. Anyone on call?

linda: Saw a few 504s from model-serving. Which namespace/cluster?

anna: staging / redwood-keystore.

raj: I shipped an RBAC tighten for keystore-proxy-sa last night (PR #6124) to remove list/watch on audit CRD. Might be related if the proxy scrapes audit settings.

tom: We also rolled netpol v2 today (egress rewrite). Node conntrack spiked during rollout. Could be connection exhaustion to KMS.

sec-bot: ALERT: metric(kms.decrypt.events) down 80% for svc-keystore-staging in 10m — rule kms-audit-missing.

linda: Pulling logs:
```
kubectl -n redwood-keystore logs deploy/keystore-proxy --since=15m
kubectl -n redwood-keystore get pods -o wide
kubectl -n redwood-keystore exec deploy/keystore-proxy -- curl -sv http://127.0.0.1:8080/health
```

anna: Two quick mitigations: (1) add temporary egress allow for KMS IP in netpol, (2) prepare ephemeral key rotation and failover to fallback KMS endpoint in staging.

raj: RBAC change only touched k8s api perms, not KMS creds. But the proxy reads audit CRD; if that read fails it will suppress audit forwarding. I can revert RBAC if needed.

tom: Checking conntrack on nodes now. Commands: 
```
sudo conntrack -S | grep entries
sudo sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_count
```

linda: Proxy logs show: 
```
ERR dial tcp <kms-ip>:443: connect: connection timed out
WARN audit: missing decrypt record for req=abcd-1234
```
TLS handshake timeouts from egress-proxy pods too.

anna: That points to network path issues. Tom, is conntrack saturated?

tom: Node-5 conntrack at 94% of limit, spike aligns with netpol rollout at 17:12 UTC. I can bump conntrack on staging nodes as short-term fix.

raj: Opening incident ticket INC-2026-staging-keystore. Action plan: 1) temp netpol allow to KMS, 2) bump conntrack on staging nodes, 3) rotate ephemeral keystore creds, 4) monitor audit events to confirm recovery.

linda: Applying temp netpol patch now. Patch: 
```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: tmp-allow-kms-egress
  namespace: redwood-keystore
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: keystore-proxy
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: <kms-ip>/32
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```

sec-bot: NOTE: INC-2026 created and routed to sec-oncall (P1).

tom: Increased conntrack limit on staging nodes via remote-run.

linda: After netpol patch, TLS connects succeed and decrypt logs reappear: 
```
INFO decrypt success req=abcd-1234 svc=svc-model-serving user=svc-account
```

anna: Good. Next: (a) add conntrack sysctl to Terraform for staging, (b) revert tmp netpol allow and instead tune egress-proxy (keepalive, pool size, dial timeout), (c) schedule post-incident to analyze netpol rollout ordering and rate.

raj: I'll leave RBAC revert on standby; not needed now but will add note to PR #6124 that CRD reads are sensitive to transient network errors.

tom: Filing short postmortem for staging blast — recommend adding conntrack headroom and reviewing netpol rollout order to avoid mass connection churn.

anna: Thanks all. Keep major updates in INC-2026 and paste key findings here. :thumbsup:
